generate_text_with_prompt: generate text from a starting prompt using a trained Keras model with random or greedy sampling
sample_token_from_probs: sample a token index from a probability distribution using JAX random choice with a PRNG key
greedy_decode_token: select the highest probability token index from a predicted next token probability distribution
generate_text_greedy_mode: generate text using greedy decoding mode to always pick the most likely next token
generate_text_random_mode: generate text using random sampling mode to produce diverse outputs from a Keras model
